s: Din qeshira vaaniba beshabbat ubo y"a seipim: haqqosher vehammattir hen meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu tzayyade chillazon qosherin umattirin berishtotehen, shekkol reshatot asuyot qesharim qesharim, vehen qishre qayyama, upeamim shetztzarik littol chutin mereshet zo ulehosip al zo, umattir mikkan veqosher mikkan. Umin hattora eno chayyab ella al qesher shel qayyama haomed lehitqayyem leolam, dehaynu sheqqoshero al daat sheyyishshaer ken kol zeman sheepshar lo lihyot qayyam vekol zeman shello yitztarek lo lehattiro. Veap al pi sheepshar sheyyitztarek lo lehattiro bizman qarob veyattirennu, ap al pi ken hoil ukesheqqoshero eno qotzeb zeman bedato matay yattirennu, veepshar sheyyishshaer ken leolam — hare zeh niqra qesher shel qayyama, vechayyabim al qeshirato veal hattarato. Abal im qotzeb bedato ezeh zeman sheaz yattirennu bevadday, apillu hu zeman arok meod — en zeh shel qayyama min hattora, upatur ben al qeshirato ben al hattarato. Abal middibre soperim niqra zeh gam ken shel qayyama, hoil veomed lehitqayyem ezeh zeman, veasur ben leqoshro ben lehattiro. Abal im eno omed lehitqayyem kelal, ella lehattiro beyomo, kegon qesharim shebbemalbushim uminalim, shekkeshellobeshan shacharit qosheran ukeshepposhetan arbit mattiran — muttar leqoshran ulehattiran beshabbat. Abal im hu bedato shello lehattiran beyoman, kegon talmide chakamim shellomedim ballelot veenam choletzin minalehen velo poshetim malbushehen ballayla — asurim leqoshram beshabbat shacharit im bedatam shello lehattiran arbit. Veken asurim lehattiran beshabbat im kesheqqasheru otan beechad mimot hachol haya bedatam shello lehattiram miyyad ballayla shelleacharayv. Abal im en bedatam kelum kesheqqosherin, ella qosherim setam — muttarim leqoshram beshabbat. Veap sheachar kak enan mattirin otan ballayla ad leachar ezeh zeman — enan niqraim bishbil kak qesher shel qayyama, hoil ubishat haqqeshira lo haya haddabar vadday shello yattiru otan belel motzae shabbat, shehare lipamim gam hattalmide chakamim choletzim minalehem ballayla terem yishkabu. Veken muttarin lehattiran beshabbat im qasheru setam, apillu qasheru lipne hashshabbat zeman merubbeh velo hittiru benetayim. Abal qesharim shelleolam darko leqayyeman ezeh zeman bevadday, veen darko leolam lehattiro beyoman — asur leqoshran beshabbat apillu bistam, o lehattiram. Veyesh omerim, shekkol qesher sheeno omed lehitqayyem shiba yamim — eno niqra qesher shel qayyama apillu middibre soperim, umuttar leqoshro ulehattiro beshabbat. Vaapillu im rob happeamim darko leqayyeman shiba yamim, ella shellipamim gam ken mattir oto betok shiba, kegon talmid chakam sherob happeamim eno choletz minalayv velo poshet malbushayv ki im mishshabbat leshabbat, shennimtza meqayyem qishrehem shiba yamim, velipamim gam ken mattiran tok shiba — enan niqraim qesher shel qayyama, ella im ken yesh bedato bishat qeshiratan shello lehattiran ad leachar shiba. Abal im qosheran setam — enan niqraim shel qayyama, ella im ken darko leolam leqayyemam shiba yamim, kegon hammeshichot sheqqosherin bahen bet hatztzavvar shel hakketonet, mi sheen darko leolam lehattiran ella keshemmechallep hakketonet mishshabbat leshabbat — asur leqoshran ulehattiran beshabbat. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kasbara harishona, ella im ken tzarik harbeh lekak — azay yesh lehaqel laasot al yede nokri:

Yesh omerim sheen chayyabim min hattora, apillu al qesher haomed lehitqayyem leolam, ella im ken hu maaseh uman, dehaynu shehu qesher chazaq veammitz kiqsharim shehaummanim osim bishat melaktan, kegon qishre retzuot minal vesandal sheqqosherin haratzanin bishat asiyyatan, veken bekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal haqqosher qesher shel qayyama veeno maaseh uman — patur. Ketzad? Nipseqa lo retzua uqesharah, nipsaq hachebel uqesharo, o sheqqashar chebel bidli, o sheqqashar resen habbehema, veken kol kayyotze baellu haqqesharim shehem maaseh hedyot vekol adam qosher otam leqayyama — patur, abal asur middibre soperim, apillu eno omed lehitqayyem leolam ella keshiur shennitbaer. Abal qesher shehu maaseh uman, apillu eno asuy lehitqayyem kelal ella lehattiro beyomo — asur middibre soperim leqoshro ulehattiro beshabbat, gezera mishshum qesher maaseh uman heasuy lehitqayyem leolam, shechayyabim alayv min hattora. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq kelal ben maaseh uman lemaaseh hedyot, sheapillu qesher shehu maaseh hedyot chayyabim alayv min hattora im hu shel qayyama, veim eno omed lehitqayyem kelal beinyan shemmuttar bemaaseh hedyot — muttar gam ken bemaaseh uman. Veyesh lehachamir kasbara harishona. Velaken nahagu lizzaher shello liqshor o lehattir shum qesher shehu shene qesharim zeh al zeh, apillu hu omed lehattiro beyomo, mippene sheen anu beqiin ezeh qesher niqra maaseh uman, sheasur leqoshro ulehattiro apillu eno omed lehitqayyem kelal, vekol qesher ammitz shehu qashur hadeq heteb — yesh lehistappeq bo shemma zehu maaseh uman, ushene qesharim zeh al gabbe zeh hu gam ken qesher ammitz. Umikkol maqom, bimqom tzaar en lehachamir bedibre soperim, umuttar lehattiro im eno omed lehitqayyem kelal beinyan shemmuttar bevadday maaseh hedyot, kevan shellepi sebara haacharona muttar apillu bevadday maaseh uman:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishne qesharim zeh al zeh, abal qesher echad vaaniba al gabbayv — en lehistappeq bo kelal beqesher maaseh uman, umuttar leqoshro ulehattiro bekol inyan im eno omed lehitqayyem kelal. Veim eno ella qesher echad bilbad belo aniba al gabbayv — eno niqra qesher kelal, umuttar leqoshro ulehattiro apillu im omed lehitqayyem leolam. Vekol zeh beqosher shene debarim beyachad, abal im asa qesher berosh echad shel chebel o chut o meshicha — dino kishne qesharim zeh al zeh lekol dabar:

Qesher sheeno niqra shel qayyama min hattora ella middibre soperim — muttar leqoshro letzorek mitzva, kegon sheqqosher limdod echad mishshiure tora. Vaapillu qesher maaseh uman muttar liqshor, im i epshar limdod beinyan acher:

Nishmetu lo retzuot minal vesandal — muttar lehachaziran limqoman, ubilbad shello yaaseh qesher berosh haretzua kede shello tishshamet min hanneqeb, mippene shehu qesher shel qayyama. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimqomot sheen regilin sham liqshor qesher zeh, abal bimqomot shergilin leqoshro — asur apillu lehachazir, gezera shemma yiqshor. Vaapillu bimqomot sheen regilin — lo hittiru ella lehachazir, abal beminal chadash asur litten haretzua beshabbat, mippene shehu metaqqen keli. Vaapillu lehachazir lo hittiru ella keshehanneqeb hu rachab veyakol lehachazir beli torach, abal im hanneqeb hu tzar shetztzarik torach lehaknis haretzua betoko — en zeh kemachazir, ella kenoten battechilla, veasur mishshum tiqqun keli. Veken haddin birtzuot shel miknasayim. Abal abnet muttar lehaknis bemiknasayim battechilla beshabbat, mippene sheeno mebattelo sham, veasuy lehaknis ulehotzi tadir, lepikak en bo mishshum tiqqun keli. Abal asur lehaknis meshicha lesham, mippene shemmebattelah sham:

Mattirin bet hatztzavvar miqqesher sheqqesharo kobes, sheeno qesher shel qayyama, sherob happeamim mattirin oto beyomo miyyad achar hakkebisa. Abal en potechin oto mechadash, mippene shehu metaqqen keli, vechayyab mishshum makkeh bappattish. Abal mishshum qorea eno chayyab, ella im ken oseh al menat litpor, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Apillu im kebar niptach bet hatztzavvar, raq shechazar hauman uteparo beyachad kederek shehaummanim osim, o sheqqesharo hauman veeno yakol lehattiro — asur lachtok hachutin. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beqesher zeh sheqqesharo hauman qodem gemar meleket habbeged, shechatikat chute qesher zeh yesh bah mishshum "makkeh bappattish", lepi shehi gemar meleket habbeged, sheal yede kak metuqqan habbeged lelobsho, veqodem laken lo haya metuqqan meolam lelobsho, vekol dabar shehu gemar melaka yesh bo mishshum "makkeh bappattish", kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Abal shear qeshirot shenniqsheru achar gemar meleket habbeged, kegon qishre hakkibbus o hammeshichot shebbiktonet shenniqsheru veeno yakol lehattiran — muttar lechattekan. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel bipne am haaretz, ella yaaseh betzina. Veim eno ragil lehattir hammeshichot ella keshemmachalip hakketonet mishshabbat leshabbat — asur lechattekan, kemo sheasur lehattir:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Biqshira, abal im tapar hakkobes et bet hatztzavvar, veken zug shel minalim hattepurim yachad kederek shehaummanim osim — asur lechattekan o lenatteqan zeh mizzeh, sheen chilluq bitpira ben shel qayyama leenah shel qayyama, uleolam yesh bistiratah mishshum qorea. Veep shehaqqorea eno chayyab ella im ken oseh al menat litpor, mikkol maqom middibre soperim asur bekol inyan. Veyesh mattirin bitpira sheenah shel qayyama lenatteq o lachtok. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel bipne am haaretz:

Qosherin deli al pi habbor bimshicha o beabnet vekayyotze bo, middabar sheeno mebattelo sham. Abal lo bechebel, mippene shemmebattelo sham, vahare zeh qesher shel qayyama, shehare haddeli taluy veqashur sham tamid. Vaapillu bechebel shel gardi shehu chashub veeno mebattelo sham — asur, gezera mishshum shear chabalim. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bidlayim haqqebuim babbor, abal delayim shellanu sheenan qebuin babbor — eno qesher shel qayyama, umuttar apillu bishar chabalim. Ubilbad shello yehe haqqesher maaseh uman, sheasur apillu beenah shel qayyama, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Qosherim chebel bipne happara berochab happetach bishbil shello tetze, mippene sheeno shel qayyama, sheasuy lehattiro tadir lehotzi habbehema lehashqotah. Vaapillu liqshor beshabbat shene rashe hachebel bishne tzidde happetach, shello haya taluy kelal bappetach meetmol — muttar, veen chosheshin shemma yebattel rosh echad sheyyehe qashur leolam veyotzi habbehema behattarat rosh hashsheni bilbad, ella lipamim yattir rosh zeh velipamim yattir zeh. Abal im beemet mebattel rosh echad — asur:

Kol qesher shellipamim nimlak umebattelo leolam, ap al pi shebbitchillat asiyyato enah al menat lebattelo — asur, shemma yimmalek vibattelennu. Lepikak, asur littol chebel uleqoshro baebus ubappara, shemma kesheyyirtzeh leholik habbehema lo yattir leolam ella rosh echad veyanniach hashsheni qayyam leolam, veyihyeh qesher shel qayyama. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishar chabalim, abal bechebel shel gardi — muttar, sheeno mebattelo sham. Veen ligzor kan al shel gardi mishshum shear chabalim, mippene sheggam bishar chabalim eno matzuy sheyyebattel rosh echad leolam, ella lipamim mattir rosh zeh velipamim mattir zeh. Vekol zeh liqshor hachebel beshabbat baebus ubappara, abal im haya qashur kebar baebus verotzeh leqoshro atta bappara, o shehaya qashur bappara verotzeh atta leqoshro baebus — muttar bekol chebel, lepi sheim ba lebattel qesher echad mehem sheyyehe qashur leolam — min hassetam oto qesher shehaya qashur kebar mannicho leolam qashur:

Happotel chabalim, mikkol min sheyyihyeh — chayyab mishshum qosher. Veshiuro lehitchayyeb min hattora, kede sheyyaamod hachebel biptilato belo qeshira besopo, shennimtzet melakto mitqayyemet. Abal middibre soperim asur bekol shehu. Veken hammaprid happatil — chayyab mishshum mattir. Veshiuro keshiur happotel. Vehu shello yitkavven leqalqel, shekkol hamqalqelim peturin min hattora, abal asur middibre soperim:
